prompt: This calls the function whose address is in `rdi` exactly n times (`rsi`). Tap the line that fails on the second pass.
code:
apply_n:
    push rbx
    mov rbx, rsi
.Lagain:
    test rbx, rbx
    jz .Ldone
    call rdi
    dec rbx
    jmp .Lagain
.Ldone:
    pop rbx
    ret
explain: `rdi` is caller-saved, so the callee may change it. The loop needs the function pointer in a callee-saved register such as r12 (saved and restored) and `call r12`.
